problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit of 10 regional warehouses for a critical supply distribution run. The geographical positions of the warehouses are precisely mapped as follows:

Warehouse Alpha: Coordinates (116,87)
Warehouse Beta: Coordinates (133,36)
Warehouse Gamma: Coordinates (90,118)
Warehouse Delta: Coordinates (161,163)
Warehouse Epsilon: Coordinates (22,123)
Warehouse Zeta: Coordinates (193,52)
Warehouse Theta: Coordinates (75,0)
Warehouse Eta: Coordinates (178,114)
Warehouse Iota: Coordinates (158,118)
Warehouse Kappa: Coordinates (1,55)

The travel distances, measured in kilometers along the available transport links, are provided:

Alpha to Gamma: 40.5 km
Alpha to Delta: 88.3 km
Alpha to Epsilon: 100.7 km
Alpha to Zeta: 84.6 km
Alpha to Theta: 96.2 km
Alpha to Eta: 67.6 km
Alpha to Iota: 52.2 km
Alpha to Kappa: 119.4 km
Beta to Gamma: 92.6 km
Beta to Delta: 130.0 km
Beta to Epsilon: 141.0 km
Beta to Zeta: 62.1 km
Beta to Theta: 68.3 km
Beta to Eta: 90.0 km
Beta to Iota: 85.7 km
Beta to Kappa: 133.4 km
Gamma to Delta: 84.1 km
Gamma to Epsilon: 68.2 km
Gamma to Zeta: 122.3 km
Gamma to Theta: 118.9 km
Gamma to Eta: 88.1 km
Gamma to Iota: 68.0 km
Gamma to Kappa: 109.0 km
Delta to Epsilon: 144.6 km
Delta to Zeta: 115.5 km
Delta to Theta: 184.3 km
Delta to Eta: 51.9 km
Delta to Iota: 45.1 km
Delta to Kappa: 193.0 km
Epsilon to Zeta: 185.2 km
Epsilon to Theta: 133.9 km
Epsilon to Eta: 156.3 km
Epsilon to Iota: 136.1 km
Epsilon to Kappa: 71.2 km
Zeta to Theta: 128.9 km
Zeta to Eta: 63.8 km
Zeta to Iota: 74.7 km
Zeta to Kappa: 192.0 km
Theta to Eta: 153.6 km
Theta to Iota: 144.3 km
Theta to Kappa: 92.2 km
Eta to Iota: 20.4 km
Eta to Kappa: 186.6 km
Iota to Kappa: 169.2 km

Due to a regulatory restriction, no direct transport link exists between Warehouse Alpha and Warehouse Beta. Furthermore, operational protocols mandate that the final route must incorporate exactly one of two specific critical links: either the connection between Warehouse Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Warehouse Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed circuit that visits every warehouse precisely one time before returning to the point of origin.
